title: Dave Gibbons
description: The Jawas lead Threepio to their sandcrawler. "No doubt he's complaining as usual!" comments Dave Gibbons. "It's great to get a chance to do something connected to STAR WARS. I've loved it since I went to a press preview, way back in 1977, and sat open-mouthed throughout." Gibbons, who lives in England, has been working in comics since 1973, drawing HARLEM HEROES, DAN DARE and ROGUE TROOPER for the British weekly 2000 AD. Since then, he has drawn and written for most comics publishers on both sides of the Atlantic. His work has encompassed DR. WHO, SUPERMAN, BATMAN, GREEN LANTERN, the Hugo award-winning WATCHMEN and GIVE ME LIBERTY
